acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the CLI package archetypes/ directory, When inspected, Then it contains base.json (abstract) and 6 concrete archetype JSON files all valid against archetype.schema.json.

Given a concrete archetype name, When `npx nit archetype <name>` is executed, Then the command outputs a flat JSON object containing the resolved steps array, engineerRole, and rejectionRouting, with `$engineer` replaced by engineerRole and `$detect` preserved.
Given the abstract base archetype, When `npx nit archetype base` is executed, Then the command exits with a non-zero code and rejects use of the abstract archetype.
Given an archetype whose parent itself extends another archetype, When the resolver runs, Then it rejects multi-level inheritance with a clear error.
Given a child archetype with overrides, When resolved, Then removeSteps is applied first, then step property modifications, then addSteps, producing a deterministic merged step list.
